name: Weatherization and Energy Efficiency Programs
description: Free major home improvements to reduce energy usage (weatherization) and electric efficiency audits, for homeowners and renters who receive fuel assistance or the utility discount rate.
documents_needed: Name, LIHEAP application number (if you have one), home address, phone and email
Copy of electric bill (and natural gas account number/bill if not on fuel assistance)

requirements.text: You must receive fuel assistance or the utility discount rate for electricity or natural gas.

Renters can apply but need landlord authorization; for 2-4 unit properties at least half of the tenants must meet the income-eligibility requirement; buildings over 4 units are referred to Lean Multifamily.

unknowns: Income limits (none stated beyond fuel assistance / discount rate participation)
Whether this is the federal Weatherization Assistance Program (WAP) (page does not name it)
